name: India–Pakistan
summary: Border shootings and Line of Control firing keep tensions elevated
state: Indian border guards shot dead two people on the Punjab border on 2 Oct, and both countries summoned diplomats (Al Jazeera, 3 Oct). No cross-border military strikes have occurred since the 2025 clashes, and no new LoC incident was reported to 1 Nov.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice for areas near the India–Pakistan border and Line of Control.
